target: Allow existing source-hash-bound semantic jobs to drain independently while archive integrity debt remains visible and blocks creation of new summary work.
primary_semantics: Archive-level integrity debt is an attention state and a scheduling barrier, not a global dispatch barrier for already frozen jobs.
invariants: Raw history and completed summary Markdown remain immutable authorities.
Integrity debt remains visible and prevents creation of new summary jobs until repaired.
Every frozen job revalidates its source SHA-256 before ingestion.
A failed or quarantined job does not block an independent healthy sibling.
A quarantined job is never counted as completed or silently removed.
allowed_changes: Remove the archive-wide semantic dispatch stop for already frozen jobs.
Report the integrity-debt dispatch policy in maintenance diagnostics.
Add focused regressions for mixed quarantined and healthy frozen jobs.
Update version metadata and three-locale release documentation.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite, normalize, delete, or automatically repair Raw history.
Create new summary jobs from an archive with unresolved integrity or repairable drift.
Relax per-job source SHA-256 validation or summary ingestion validation.
Change archive schemas, summary formats, trigger thresholds, collector formats, cloud protocols, dashboard behavior, or Summary V2 behavior.
Treat an integrity warning, quarantined job, or incomplete source range as healthy or completed.
before_after_checks: Reproduce archive integrity debt causing zero selected frozen jobs before the patch.
Require one bad job to remain quarantined while one healthy sibling completes in the same patched batch.
Require the installed Windows maintenance entrypoint to reduce pending summary debt without clearing the integrity warning or creating a new job.

original_triggers: Archive-level duplicate sequence and sequence-gap findings forced every frozen semantic job to remain unselected.
Malformed rollout isolation in Capture Core did not propagate to the semantic maintenance entrypoint.
A historical release-contract test asserted the obsolete global dispatch implementation token instead of the durable raw-authority invariant.

failure_escalation.first_failure: Keep the installed 2.19.1 hotfix and repair only the failing targeted scenario without touching raw history.
failure_escalation.after_limit: Do not merge, tag, publish, or replace the installed candidate; preserve evidence for a new decision.

rollback: Restore the exact pre-hotfix semantic_backfill.py or install the previous verified 2.19.1 generation; raw history and completed summaries require no rollback.
